    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AdminFrame
    AdminFrame is a GUI window for managing users in the admin panel.
    App
    The main application entry point for the 2D-Duniya project.
    Category
    Enumeration of project categories in the 2D-Duniya application.
    CurrentUser
    Represents the currently logged-in user with their username.
    CurrentUserController
    Manages the current logged-in user, providing login, logout, and user retrieval functionality.
    IndividualProjectFrame
     
    KeyboardUtils
    Utility class for enabling keyboard navigation in Swing text components.
    MyQueue<T>
    A generic circular queue implementation using an array.
    MyStack<T>
    A generic stack implementation using an array.
    Project
    Represents a project with its name, file path, creation date, and deletion date.
    ProjectDataController
    Manages data for a specific project, handling loading, saving, and modifying project-specific data stored in a file.
    ProjectItem
    Represents an item within a project, with name, creation date, and category.
    ProjectsController
    Manages projects, favourites, and trash for the current user, handling loading, saving, and CRUD operations.
    ProjectsController.TrashItem
    Represents a project in the trash with its deletion timestamp.
    ProjectsFrame
    ProjectsFrame is a GUI window for managing projects, including viewing, creating, favouriting, and deleting projects.
    Registerframe
     
    User
    Represents a user with name, email, and password.
    UserController
    Handles user registration, login, password reset, and user data persistence.
    UserManager
    Manages user data operations like loading, saving, deleting, searching, and sorting users.
